prompt: Which compound would show TWO sharp N-H bands around 3300-3500 cm⁻¹ in its IR?

options.label: A primary amine (R-NH₂ has symmetric + asymmetric N-H stretches)
A secondary amine (only ONE N-H band)

concepts: counting N-H bands by amine class
explanation: 1° amines have 2 N-H → 2 bands (one symmetric, one asymmetric stretch). 2° amines have 1 N-H → 1 band. 3° amines have 0 N-H → no N-H band. 1° amides also show 2 N-H bands but combined with the strong amide C=O at ~1650.
